game_concept: A speed quiz set in Shadow Cave – Glowworm Gallery, a ceiling of glowworms: the dwarf scout must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Accumulator Pump: Add values each pass until the running total reaches the goal.
theme: Shadow Cave – Glowworm Gallery: a ceiling of glowworms
core_gameplay_loop: In Glowworm Gallery, repeat each round: Add values each pass until the running total reaches the goal. Each round, a new arrows challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the total value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 290 points of arrows by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 290, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Accumulator Pump
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Accumulator Pump' (Week 4 slot 6), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Glowworm Gallery'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how total changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cave spiders in Glowworm Gallery.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 290 within 76 seconds.
